description.narrative: (Ghana): With FY 2022 funds, this activity will increase access to sustainable water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) services by strengthening governance and finance; expanding WASH services to health facilities, communities, and households; improving private sector engagement; and accelerating the adoption of key WASH behaviors. It will target the 17 northern Ghana districts that comprise the Feed the Future zone of influence and also extend to areas in the regions of Savannah and Oti with lower WASH metrics. The activity will partner with the GOG to improve WASH sector governance and leverage public/private sector partnerships to increase use of basic sanitation, expand adoption of key hygiene behaviors, and increase water and sanitation services and infrastructure for the benefit of target populations. The Activity will work in schools targeting adolescent girls with menstrual hygiene education and distribution of menstrual hygiene pants, as well as with boys to improve awareness and understanding of menstrual hygiene. The activity will also strengthen the GOG's COVID-19 pandemic response by supporting Government of Ghana and Health Sector Institutions and mobilizing communities and populations for education and awareness accretion about COVID-19. This includes support to health facilities to increase the availability of handwashing stations and improve infection prevention, and control measures. The activity facilitates partnerships with central government ministries and sub-national structures including municipal authorities, and the private sector. The activity will also work with partners to ensure sustainable financing, promote strong decentralized governance and management, and encourage community participation and ownership of WASH services.
